text:
marta_cs: Week0 quick sync for CourierLane private deploy. Smoke tests mostly good but Splunk shows no audit events. Suspect KMS/IAM or sampling. @alex_courierlane can you confirm collector account?

alex_courierlane: Collector 9876543210. S3 shows objects; Splunk index empty.

omar_infra: First check KMS key policy allows decrypt for arn:aws:iam::9876543210:role/splunk-forwarder and that key is in same region.

kai_engineer: Example minimal policy we use: ```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::9876543210:role/splunk-forwarder"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],"Resource":"*"}]}```

leila_support: Also check Console > Observability > Audit export sampling. If set to 0 nothing is forwarded.

marta_cs: Actions: 1) @alex update KMS policy if needed; 2) confirm sampling > 0; 3) @kai share short decrypt check. I'll log blocker on healthcard.

opsbot: Ticket CS-4850 created: "CourierLane Splunk ingestion missing (KMS/IAM/sampling)" https://redwood.internal/tickets/CS-4850

alex_courierlane: Updated policy to allow forwarder role and bumped sampling to 5%. Running a replay now.

omar_infra: When you replay, check CloudTrail for KMS Deny entries to capture signature.

alex_courierlane: Replay successful, events appear in Splunk. No KMS Deny entries. Sampling was the root cause.

kai_engineer: Quick decrypt test we use: ```sh
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit-bucket/... - | head
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://obj.enc --key-id arn:aws:kms:... --query Plaintext --output text | base64 --decode > /tmp/log````

leila_support: Noting renewal risk: minor. Recommend runbook session with customer SRE and 2-week follow-up.

marta_cs: Week0 status yellow, renewal risk flagged minor. Follow-up call Thu 14:00 PT. Adding onboarding retro note: default sampling should be 5% for first 72h.

alex_courierlane: Thanks team, will ping if anything else.
